Name: Spooky Halloween Inspired Crops
Author: sakialyn
Description:
It's Spooky Time, and that means spooky crops and goods to go along with it. All crops grow in the fall and can be bought from Pierre's store.

Crop details below:

[spoiler][b]Candy Corn[/b] - can be made into [b]Candy Corn Muffins[/b]
[b]Ghost Jellies[/b] - can be made into [b]Ghost Jelly Cookies[/b]
[b]Spider Silk[/b] - can be made into [b]Spider Silk Thread[/b]
[b]Eyeball Grapes[/b] - can be squeezed and made into [b]Eyeball Juice[/b]
[b]Full Moon Squash[/b] - can be made into [b]Baked Werewolf Bites[/b]
[b]Plasma Peach[/b] - can be made into [b]Vampiric Peach Pie[/b]
[b]Hexed Potato[/b] - can be made into [b]Witches Cauldron Stew[/b]
[b]Zombie Bean[/b] - can be turned into [b]Resurrection Espresso [/b]
[b]Femur Stalk[/b] - which can be made into [b]Bone Marrow Flour[/b] to make special breads and cakes 
[b]Jack O'Lantern[/b] - can be made into a [b]Spooky Pumpkin Cake[/b]
[b]Trick or Treat Candy[/b] - which can be combined into a [b]Bowl of Spooky Treats[/b]
[b]Midnight Pepper[/b] - can be made into [b]Pickled Midnight Peppers

[/b]Recipes for these can be bought from Gus[/spoiler]

There may also be some surprises if you throw these into a keg or preserves jar. Happy Halloween!

Pairs well with JazzMinK's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4266]Halloween Feelings[/url] map mod!

Downloads.Description: Added compatibility with Flexible Cooking as well as config options to exclude items added by this mod from Perfection. Also added better organized i18n file for easier translation. Big thank you to Hayato2236 for organizing it!
